_how_to_edit: Every chapter is one dish on the table. Every entry is one spread (two pages) of the book. Change the words between the quotes. Fields you can use in any entry: name, served, tag, ingredients (a list), method, notes, photo, video. For photo/video, put the file in public/media/ and write it like "/media/my-photo.jpg" or "/media/my-clip.mp4". Leave a field as "" to hide it. Keep method to about 3 sentences so it fits the page. Stories: add a "story" list to any entry. Each block is one of {"type":"text","content"}, {"type":"image","src","caption"}, {"type":"video","src","poster","caption"}, {"type":"quote","content"}. Long stories continue onto the next page automatically; blocks containing [PLACEHOLDER] stay hidden.

entries.name: The Free Fall Spritz
ingredients: a dash of “what am I doing”
entries.method: Climb into a tiny plane. Regret everything. Jump anyway, scream for sixty seconds straight, then land and immediately want to go again.

story.content: The plane door opened and the world became a rumour. For one long breath there was no up or down, only wind and a thin, bright thread of courage.
“Begin at the beginning,” the King said gravely, “and go on till you come to the end: then stop.”

story.caption: Somewhere above the clouds, moonlit and quiet.

story.content: Then the parachute bloomed, and everything went soft and golden, and I laughed all the way down to the grass.

story.caption: The fall, seen through the looking-glass.

entries.name: The Midnight Dip
entries.method: Count to three. Lie about counting to three. Go in on two. Come out laughing and unable to feel your face.

story.content: The lake held its breath. We counted, we cheated, we shrieked, and the cold came up like a bell being rung inside my chest.

story.caption: A frozen lake under a drifting moon.

story.content: “It’s no use going back to yesterday, because I was a different person then.”
